## Purpose
`dispatch_plan.rs`'s `DispatchItem` is the model for this role: one row of a deterministic, ordered array the orchestrator iterates to drive dispatch (or summary, or wave advance) without deciding order itself. An Item struct is the unit of a `Vec<Item>` that IS the command's whole output — unlike a Report, there is no separate `ok`/wrapper struct; the array itself is the answer (or is wrapped minimally).

## Convention
Folder: apps/rt/src/commands/pipeline/** · Extension: .rs · Files of this role in this subproject: 3
`DispatchItem` (`dispatch_plan.rs`) derives `Debug, Clone, Serialize, PartialEq, Eq`, documents every field's meaning (including how ordering — `(level, wave)` — is derived) directly on the struct, and is built by a `build_plan`/`build_plan_with_cycle` function that stays fail-open on a malformed input (missing wave-plan, contradictory dependency graph) rather than panicking. Fields that are ready-to-run strings (`prompt_cmd`) are documented as "run this, relay stdout" rather than "this is the payload" — the caller must not misuse the field as pre-rendered content.

## How to apply
A new pipeline-array command (wave-advance, pipeline-summary) defines its own `<Name>Item` next to the function building it, deriving the same trait set (`Debug, Clone, Serialize, PartialEq, Eq`) and documenting the deterministic sort key on the struct's doc comment, matching `DispatchItem`'s `(level, wave)` convention.
